bio: Beneath a thatched roof and smothered in Virginia creeper, this spruce, hundred-year-old inn has been welcoming travellers since 1926. Three generations have preserved its authentic character, whilst breathing a new lease of life thanks to a tasteful restoration. The same spirit prevails on the menu, with traditional fare and market-fresh dishes made with premium produce. The house signature is lobster stew in season. Terrace in the shade of old plane trees. The epitome of a French country inn!...
